clips.title: The story
paras: At the Barrens oases, Horde adventurers gather Fungal Spores for Apothecary Helbrim of the Royal Apothecary Society. Strange, mutative energies flow through the springs and alter the local plants into potent reagents. Helbrim seeks the specimens to brew concoctions for his colleague in Thunder Bluff.

The Barrens is a dry savanna, but the Forgotten Pools, Lushwater Oasis, and Stagnant Oasis brim with unnatural vitality. A curious surge of life energy flows from their waters, warping and invigorating plants and beasts that drink there. Laden mushrooms grow along the muddy banks, absorbing those currents. Their spores hold rare properties that draw the curiosity of passing alchemists.

Apothecary Helbrim works at the Crossroads, far from the Undercity, yet remains devoted to the Royal Apothecary Society's research. He gathers the altered spores because Kalimdor's native reagents have strange potency, and he uses them to craft powerful mixtures. The specimens are destined for Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, part of the Forsaken's scientific work across allied lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.
There is a mushroom that grows near these oases. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.
Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the spores, friend? There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.
I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, friend.
